description: List the enabled maintenance windows in effect at this moment, to tell whether a monitor's alerts are silenced now. An ORG-scope window covers every monitor, a MONITOR-scope one its monitor_ids. For every window, including future and disabled ones, use list_maintenance_windows. Returns a plain array (not a page) of list_maintenance_windows items; empty when nothing is silenced.
name: list_active_maintenance
title: List maintenance windows in effect now
